- Plan and schedule a 2-hour enablement session for your engineering and solution architects

Best,

2) Allowlist 52.34.120.0/22 and outbound 443 to api.redwood-inference.test.

5) Confirm timezone for the session attendees (we have Samir in PST).

I also included a short validation script (in the curl file) that verifies KV cache behavior by sending a two-step conversation and checking token counts. Recommend they run it once before the session.

I'll update the shared Drive with the finalized lab deck and an A/B troubleshooting decision tree.
